bio: As High Prince Malkanis' spymaster, any information on Erdix is highly classified. His assignments are top secret, any details of his private life or family connections have been expunged from the Emerald Kingdom's archives, even his name might be fake. On paper, he might as well not exist. All that is publicly known is that if you're on Erdix's hitlist, your fate is sealed.
